Write an ma_data object to an Excel workbook or R data file

Source: R/data.R
write_ma_workbook.Rd

The file type follows the extension of path: .xlsx for Excel, .rda (or .RData) for R. In an .rda file, each section is saved as its own data frame (studies, outcomes, risk_of_bias, inspect_sr, or <object_name>_studies and so on), or, for layout = "single", one data frame called object_name; load() restores them.

Usage

write_ma_workbook(
  data,
  path,
  ...,
  layout = c("sheets", "single"),
  object_name = NULL
)

Arguments

data

An ma_data object or a named list of data frames.

path

Output path ending in .xlsx, .rda or .RData.

...

Unused; must be empty.

layout

"sheets" (default) writes one sheet (or data frame) per section, which read_ma_workbook() and the app can read back. "single" writes one combined table from merge_ma_data().

object_name

For .rda files: the name of the saved data frame (layout = "single", default "ma_data"), or a prefix for the section data frames (layout = "sheets", default none). Must be a valid R name.

Value

data, invisibly.
